# Vendor note: Acme Cloud Hosting

- Service: managed Kubernetes hosting, 3 regions (EU-West, EU-Central, US-East).
- Pricing: 0.042 EUR per vCPU-hour, 0.005 EUR per GB-hour of RAM; 15% discount on a
  12-month commitment; egress billed at 0.08 EUR/GB after the first 1 TB per month.
- Term: 12 months, renews automatically for 12 months unless cancelled.
- Termination: 60 days written notice before renewal; early termination fee equal to
  25% of the remaining committed spend.
- SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime; service credits capped at 10% of the monthly invoice.
- Risks: price revision clause allows up to +8% per year; data export only via API, no
  bulk export tool; support in English only.
